title: Master Page - Verify that for the  Subscription column, no add or delete button should appear, It should simply show the no editable list of subscription columns
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
User should redirect to the master page

steps.action: Select the column type :- Subscription data source
steps.expectedResult: Subscription data source related column should be display in the grid.( no add or delete button will appear) it shows only list of column which are non editable
